title: Timeline reply budgets regress after cache session repair
fault_primitive: Redis normal-client output buffer limit repeatedly published as a MiB count instead of bytes by a detached Python maintenance process
incident_class: Abandoned operational reconciliation with a configuration unit conversion regression
symptoms: Timeline reads fail when Redis closes sessions while constructing array replies. Pods remain Running and Ready, small health requests and writes succeed, frontend and timeline services emit errors, and Redis records output-buffer disconnections. A repaired or restarted Redis cache regresses after approximately 145-153 seconds.
